independence: Checked from primary sources only. The compiled criteria notes and the other verification pass were not read.
method: Each value in guidelines.json and fds01_site/soil_criteria.json was compared with the primary source text. NEMP 3.0: the official DCCEEW PDF, fetched from its Wayback Machine capture of 15 March 2025 (dcceew.gov.au times out from this machine), text extracted page by page with pypdf 6.19.0, so PDF and printed pages are exact. ASC NEPM Schedule B1: PDF downloaded directly from legislation.gov.au and extracted with pypdf. NEMP 3.1: a text rendering of the official DCCEEW PDF through the r.jina.ai reader, because direct download and WebFetch both timed out and no archive copy exists; printed pages read from running headers (see caveat). ADWG PFAS fact sheet, ADWG table of updates and the WA Environment WAtch PFAS page: HTML downloaded directly and converted to text. Quotes are verbatim from the extracted text; ' / ' marks a line or cell break inside a table and '...' marks skipped text.

verdicts.confirmed: Value, unit, scenario, document, table and page all match the source.
verdicts.mismatch: Something the file says differs from the source (the value itself may still be right; see value_confirmed).
verdicts.could_not_verify: The source could not be reached, or the source text does not contain the claim.

file_says.note: Add PFOS and PFHxS together and compare the total with 0.07 ug/L. This rule has no separate value for PFOS or PFHxS on its own.

source_says: Table 4 Health-based guideline values developed by health authorities / Description / Sum of PFOS and PFHxS a PFOA / Drinking water quality guideline 0.07µg/L 0.56µg/L NHMRC 2011 / New Zealand Government Department of Internal Affairs 2022
a Where the criteria refer to the sum of PFOS and PFHxS, this means concentrations of PFOS only, PFHxS only, and the sum of the two.
values.reason: Value 0.07 ug/L, unit, drinking-water scenario, Table 4 and PDF page 57 (printed page 48) are all confirmed. The mismatch is in the note. Footnote a of Table 4 says the sum criterion means 'PFOS only, PFHxS only, and the sum of the two', so 0.07 ug/L also applies to PFOS alone and to PFHxS alone. The note's sentence 'This rule has no separate value for PFOS or PFHxS on its own' contradicts that. When both are measured, passing the sum check means both single checks pass too; but when only one of the two is reported, that one should still be compared with 0.07 ug/L rather than marked as having no value. soil_criteria.json already models the same footnote with each_member_too: true.
